hypothesis: Increasing only the trainable multiscale head width from 128 to 256 and mask prototypes from 16 to 32 may improve span/residue representation capacity; the frozen ESM-2 encoder, loss, data and evaluation stay fixed.
expected_failure_mode: Small TR166 training set causes worse overfitting and precision despite higher capacity.
decision_rule: Promising only if mean best-epoch TE82 APS exceeds the padding-safe width-128 mean by >=0.03 without a lower mean high-precision recall; otherwise discard as a larger-head negative result.
external_test_policy: Evaluate all frozen best-TE82 checkpoints once on already-viewed TE64 and CAID3 common 27; never select model or threshold on those diagnostics.
